_comment: Layout, sizing and typography for modal. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here. Figma: modal-state component set (14610:24998) — state(5) x layout-vertical(2).

base._source-width: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 358 is a fixed frame width on the modal container (375pt mobile viewport less a gutter); semantic.spacing has no such step
base._source-icon-circle-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 64x64 is a fixed frame size on the icon circle
base._source-icon-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — semantic.iconography.sizes are still 'tbd' in design.md; Figma binds the icons-size component at Size=48

_verified_from.scope: all 11 variants, depth-2 walk of state=info
_verified_from.result: 358 wide, radius 16, padding 24, root gap 24, content gap 16, wording gap 8, button gap 16. Shadow `0,2 b4 s-1 @6%` + `0,4 b6 s-1 @10%` = elevation.floating. Icon circle 64 with 8 padding, so the glyph is 48. All match.
_verified_from.noted: Figma states the icon circle radius as 48, not 9999. On a 64px square both render as a circle, so radius.full gives the same shape; recorded because the numbers differ even though the result does not.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. check-figma-icons.py holds the files in `sources` to exactly this set — an extra icon fails as loudly as a missing one, because an extra is one nobody compared. Files not listed in `sources` carry payload a caller passes, not a choice the design makes.

known_gaps: Verified against Figma 2026-08-17: every `modal` component variant carries a bound `shadow/md` effect (0 2px 4px -1px @6%, 0 4px 6px -1px @10%), which design.md names `elevation.floating` — not `elevation.modal` (= shadow/xl). This overlay binds `elevation.floating` so the render matches Figma exactly. The open question is naming, not pixels: either Figma's modal should move up to shadow/xl, or design.md's `elevation.modal` role should map to shadow/md. Today `elevation.modal` has no consumer.

Figma sets the icon circle's corner radius to a literal 48px. design.md's `radius.5xl` — the name the old Storybook tokens.ts claimed — is 32px, and `radius.7xl` is 48px. Bound to `radius.full` here because the shape is a circle and 48px on a 64px box clamps to the same result; this matches the sibling toast component's `icon-circle-radius`.

Button height (44px), button radius (8px) and the tertiary button's 1px stroke used to be restated in Modal's tokens.ts. They belong to Button and are no longer duplicated here — Modal renders the real <Button> component.
